purpose: Compare one item against a reference item.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
A + は + B + より + adjective.
The train is faster than the bus.
This year is hotter than last year.
This box is lighter than that one.
formation: A + は + B + より + adjective.
restrictions: より marks the reference point, not the item being described as greater.
mistake: Keep the direction of the comparison clear.
